name: Fortune Hit’n Roll

features.name: Forged Wilds
features.description: Sticky wilds that move and gain +1x each move.

features.name: Sticky free spins
features.description: Nine free spins with sticky wilds anywhere.

review:
A 40-line Aztec game on 5x5. Wilds can become Forged Wilds, which stick and roll up or down the reel each spin, gaining +1 multiplier with every move until they leave the grid.

Three scatters give nine free spins where every wild sticks and can land anywhere. Those moving, growing wilds make the base game far livelier than most line slots. 96.57% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
